name: T-ST
description: T-ST was a Utility Tug in use by a Rebel Alliance outpost during the Galactic Civil War, within an Imperial simulation. During an Imperial torpedo attack by Alpha Squadron TIE Bombers, T-ST attempted to board one of the Class-A cargo containers along with fellow Utility Tug T-SP. However, the ships were destroyed in the attack, along with the entire outpost.

data.name: T-ST
data.destroyed: Sometime during the Galactic Civil War
